items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Charlie Holmes as a contemporary player; Interviewee does not claim personal interaction, only acknowledges the name in the context of 'boys around there'.

ctx.x: I don't know. Because at the time, see, there were quite a few boys around there playing the same as Pete, riffing, a boy by the name of Charlie Holmes.

items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: That was Cozy Cole's younger brother, Reuben J. Cole, on piano.

ctx.x: That's right. That's who I couldn't think of his name.
That was Cozy Cole's younger brother, Reuben J. Cole, on piano. Bob Andrewwitz(?) we had on the tuba...
